title: The Last House
plot_overview: After a sudden disaster seals a family inside their home, they must find ways to endure as supplies dwindle and an ominous threat keeps them trapped. Their struggle tests their ability to stay together through isolation and an uncertain future.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like contained survival horror that pairs family tensions with an ominous threat; not for you if you want brisk pacing, a deeply explored mystery, or a fully resolved ending.
review_summary: Pros: intriguing premise; tense later stretches; committed performances | Cons: slow first half; mystery underexplored; rushed resolution
